reason: I'd love something that follows up leads while I sleep, but 'connects to your CRM, Google, Microsoft...' doesn't tell me it works with the exact tools I run. I'd sign up for the free plan and poke at it, but I'm not paying 99 a month until I see it actually doing my follow-ups.
objection: It probably doesn't plug into the specific tools I use, and then I'm the one spending nights wiring it up instead of getting hours back. 'Credits' also worries me: I don't know how far 100 a month goes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in a demo that it connects to my own inbox and CRM and sends a real follow-up to a lead without me touching it, plus a clear idea of how many tasks 100 credits covers.
